title: looking for gamedev advice
author: NugsGotMeZooted
selftext:
ive been absorbing as much as I can here and the other subs, and its helped a lot. I know I need the main hook of a good game loop, which im currently hovering. 

Im enjoying my game and im looking forward to playtesting, but at what specific point do I want open playtesting? 

Currently im building on HTML. The game doesnt need to be 3d and is 2d and is a trade and economy simulator based in medieval times. Currently, the vibe and UI is super niche and boring. Think "TribalWars" from 10+ years ago, im not sure if anyone knows about that game. it was mega niche. 

My question about the "graphics" (UI, Map graphics, interactions in the UI) is, what are some free tools Claude can use or prompts Claud would utilize to make a much, much nicer modern "pixel game" overall UI? Because right now its that barebones Claude ui on HTMLs with a OSRS color scheme going on. I dont want to burn all my tokens testing for different styles and tweaking them, because my tokens are going toward to function of the game's complex financial system.

Lastly, any general advice or tips? 

Thank you!
